definition_text: a software or hardware product and its remote data processing solutions, including software or hardware components being placed on the market separately
full_text: (1) ‘product with digital elements’ means a software or hardware product and its remote data processing solutions, including software or hardware components being placed on the market separately;

definition_text: data processing at a distance for which the software is designed and developed by the manufacturer, or under the responsibility of the manufacturer, and the absence of which would prevent the product with digital elements from performing one of its functions
full_text: (2) ‘remote data processing’ means data processing at a distance for which the software is designed and developed by the manufacturer, or under the responsibility of the manufacturer, and the absence of which would prevent the product with digital elements from performing one of its functions;

definition_text: cybersecurity as defined in Article 2, point (1), of Regulation (EU) 2019/881
full_text: (3) ‘cybersecurity’ means cybersecurity as defined in Article 2, point (1), of Regulation (EU) 2019/881;

definition_text: the part of an electronic information system which consists of computer code
full_text: (4) ‘software’ means the part of an electronic information system which consists of computer code;

definition_text: a physical electronic information system, or parts thereof capable of processing, storing or transmitting digital data
full_text: (5) ‘hardware’ means a physical electronic information system, or parts thereof capable of processing, storing or transmitting digital data;

definition_text: software or hardware intended for integration into an electronic information system
full_text: (6) ‘component’ means software or hardware intended for integration into an electronic information system;

definition_text: a system, including electrical or electronic equipment, capable of processing, storing or transmitting digital data
full_text: (7) ‘electronic information system’ means a system, including electrical or electronic equipment, capable of processing, storing or transmitting digital data;

definition_text: a virtual representation of a data connection implemented through a software interface
full_text: (8) ‘logical connection’ means a virtual representation of a data connection implemented through a software interface;

definition_text: a connection between electronic information systems or components implemented using physical means, including through electrical, optical or mechanical interfaces, wires or radio waves
full_text: (9) ‘physical connection’ means a connection between electronic information systems or components implemented using physical means, including through electrical, optical or mechanical interfaces, wires or radio waves;

definition_text: a connection to a device or network, which does not take place directly but rather as part of a larger system that is directly connectable to such device or network
full_text: (10) ‘indirect connection’ means a connection to a device or network, which does not take place directly but rather as part of a larger system that is directly connectable to such device or network;

definition_text: any device that is connected to a network and serves as an entry point to that network
full_text: (11) ‘end-point’ means any device that is connected to a network and serves as an entry point to that network;

definition_text: the manufacturer, the authorised representative, the importer, the distributor, or other natural or legal person who is subject to obligations in relation to the manufacture of products with digital elements or to the making available of products with digital elements on the market in accordance with this Regulation
full_text: (12) ‘economic operator’ means the manufacturer, the authorised representative, the importer, the distributor, or other natural or legal person who is subject to obligations in relation to the manufacture of products with digital elements or to the making available of products with digital elements on the market in accordance with this Regulation;

definition_text: a natural or legal person who develops or manufactures products with digital elements or has products with digital elements designed, developed or manufactured, and markets them under its name or trademark, whether for payment, monetisation or free of charge
full_text: (13) ‘manufacturer’ means a natural or legal person who develops or manufactures products with digital elements or has products with digital elements designed, developed or manufactured, and markets them under its name or trademark, whether for payment, monetisation or free of charge;

definition_text: a legal person, other than a manufacturer, that has the purpose or objective of systematically providing support on a sustained basis for the development of specific products with digital elements, qualifying as free and open-source software and intended for commercial activities, and that ensures the viability of those products
full_text: (14) ‘open-source software steward’ means a legal person, other than a manufacturer, that has the purpose or objective of systematically providing support on a sustained basis for the development of specific products with digital elements, qualifying as free and open-source software and intended for commercial activities, and that ensures the viability of those products;

definition_text: a natural or legal person established within the Union who has received a written mandate from a manufacturer to act on its behalf in relation to specified tasks
full_text: (15) ‘authorised representative’ means a natural or legal person established within the Union who has received a written mandate from a manufacturer to act on its behalf in relation to specified tasks;

definition_text: a natural or legal person established in the Union who places on the market a product with digital elements that bears the name or trademark of a natural or legal person established outside the Union
full_text: (16) ‘importer’ means a natural or legal person established in the Union who places on the market a product with digital elements that bears the name or trademark of a natural or legal person established outside the Union;

definition_text: a natural or legal person in the supply chain, other than the manufacturer or the importer, that makes a product with digital elements available on the Union market without affecting its properties
full_text: (17) ‘distributor’ means a natural or legal person in the supply chain, other than the manufacturer or the importer, that makes a product with digital elements available on the Union market without affecting its properties;

definition_text: a natural person who acts for purposes which are outside that person’s trade, business, craft or profession
full_text: (18) ‘consumer’ means a natural person who acts for purposes which are outside that person’s trade, business, craft or profession;

definition_text: respectively, microenterprises, small enterprises and medium-sized enterprises as defined in the Annex to Recommendation 2003/361/EC
full_text: (19) ‘microenterprises’, ‘small enterprises’ and ‘medium-sized enterprises’ mean, respectively, microenterprises, small enterprises and medium-sized enterprises as defined in the Annex to Recommendation 2003/361/EC;

definition_text: the period during which a manufacturer is required to ensure that vulnerabilities of a product with digital elements are handled effectively and in accordance with the essential cybersecurity requirements set out in Part II of Annex I
full_text: (20) ‘support period’ means the period during which a manufacturer is required to ensure that vulnerabilities of a product with digital elements are handled effectively and in accordance with the essential cybersecurity requirements set out in Part II of Annex I;

definition_text: the first making available of a product with digital elements on the Union market
full_text: (21) ‘placing on the market’ means the first making available of a product with digital elements on the Union market;

definition_text: the supply of a product with digital elements for distribution or use on the Union market in the course of a commercial activity, whether in return for payment or free of charge
full_text: (22) ‘making available on the market’ means the supply of a product with digital elements for distribution or use on the Union market in the course of a commercial activity, whether in return for payment or free of charge;

definition_text: the use for which a product with digital elements is intended by the manufacturer, including the specific context and conditions of use, as specified in the information supplied by the manufacturer in the instructions for use, promotional or sales materials and statements, as well as in the technical documentation
full_text: (23) ‘intended purpose’ means the use for which a product with digital elements is intended by the manufacturer, including the specific context and conditions of use, as specified in the information supplied by the manufacturer in the instructions for use, promotional or sales materials and statements, as well as in the technical documentation;

definition_text: use that is not necessarily the intended purpose supplied by the manufacturer in the instructions for use, promotional or sales materials and statements, as well as in the technical documentation, but which is likely to result from reasonably foreseeable human behaviour or technical operations or interactions
full_text: (24) ‘reasonably foreseeable use’ means use that is not necessarily the intended purpose supplied by the manufacturer in the instructions for use, promotional or sales materials and statements, as well as in the technical documentation, but which is likely to result from reasonably foreseeable human behaviour or technical operations or interactions;

definition_text: the use of a product with digital elements in a way that is not in accordance with its intended purpose, but which may result from reasonably foreseeable human behaviour or interaction with other systems
full_text: (25) ‘reasonably foreseeable misuse’ means the use of a product with digital elements in a way that is not in accordance with its intended purpose, but which may result from reasonably foreseeable human behaviour or interaction with other systems;

definition_text: the national authority responsible for setting up and carrying out the necessary procedures for the assessment, designation and notification of conformity assessment bodies and for their monitoring
full_text: (26) ‘notifying authority’ means the national authority responsible for setting up and carrying out the necessary procedures for the assessment, designation and notification of conformity assessment bodies and for their monitoring;

definition_text: the process of verifying whether the essential cybersecurity requirements set out in Annex I have been fulfilled
full_text: (27) ‘conformity assessment’ means the process of verifying whether the essential cybersecurity requirements set out in Annex I have been fulfilled;

definition_text: a conformity assessment body as defined in Article 2, point (13), of Regulation (EC) No 765/2008
full_text: (28) ‘conformity assessment body’ means a conformity assessment body as defined in Article 2, point (13), of Regulation (EC) No 765/2008;

definition_text: a conformity assessment body designated in accordance with Article 43 and other relevant Union harmonisation legislation
full_text: (29) ‘notified body’ means a conformity assessment body designated in accordance with Article 43 and other relevant Union harmonisation legislation;

definition_text: a change to the product with digital elements following its placing on the market, which affects the compliance of the product with digital elements with the essential cybersecurity requirements set out in Part I of Annex I or which results in a modification to the intended purpose for which the product with digital elements has been assessed
full_text: (30) ‘substantial modification’ means a change to the product with digital elements following its placing on the market, which affects the compliance of the product with digital elements with the essential cybersecurity requirements set out in Part I of Annex I or which results in a modification to the intended purpose for which the product with digital elements has been assessed;

definition_text: a marking by which a manufacturer indicates that a product with digital elements and the processes put in place by the manufacturer are in conformity with the essential cybersecurity requirements set out in Annex I and other applicable Union harmonisation legislation providing for its affixing
full_text: (31) ‘CE marking’ means a marking by which a manufacturer indicates that a product with digital elements and the processes put in place by the manufacturer are in conformity with the essential cybersecurity requirements set out in Annex I and other applicable Union harmonisation legislation providing for its affixing;

definition_text: Union legislation listed in Annex I to Regulation (EU) 2019/1020 and any other Union legislation harmonising the conditions for the marketing of products to which that Regulation applies
full_text: (32) ‘Union harmonisation legislation’ means Union legislation listed in Annex I to Regulation (EU) 2019/1020 and any other Union legislation harmonising the conditions for the marketing of products to which that Regulation applies;

definition_text: a market surveillance authority as defined in Article 3, point (4), of Regulation (EU) 2019/1020
full_text: (33) ‘market surveillance authority’ means a market surveillance authority as defined in Article 3, point (4), of Regulation (EU) 2019/1020;

definition_text: an international standard as defined in Article 2, point (1)(a), of Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012
full_text: (34) ‘international standard’ means an international standard as defined in Article 2, point (1)(a), of Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012;

definition_text: a European standard as defined in Article 2, point (1)(b), of Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012
full_text: (35) ‘European standard’ means a European standard as defined in Article 2, point (1)(b), of Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012;

definition_text: a harmonised standard as defined in Article 2, point (1)(c), of Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012
full_text: (36) ‘harmonised standard’ means a harmonised standard as defined in Article 2, point (1)(c), of Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012;

definition_text: the potential for loss or disruption caused by an incident and is to be expressed as a combination of the magnitude of such loss or disruption and the likelihood of occurrence of the incident
full_text: (37) ‘cybersecurity risk’ means the potential for loss or disruption caused by an incident and is to be expressed as a combination of the magnitude of such loss or disruption and the likelihood of occurrence of the incident;

definition_text: a cybersecurity risk which, based on its technical characteristics, can be assumed to have a high likelihood of an incident that could lead to a severe negative impact, including by causing considerable material or non-material loss or disruption
full_text: (38) ‘significant cybersecurity risk’ means a cybersecurity risk which, based on its technical characteristics, can be assumed to have a high likelihood of an incident that could lead to a severe negative impact, including by causing considerable material or non-material loss or disruption;

definition_text: a formal record containing details and supply chain relationships of components included in the software elements of a product with digital elements
full_text: (39) ‘software bill of materials’ means a formal record containing details and supply chain relationships of components included in the software elements of a product with digital elements;

definition_text: a weakness, susceptibility or flaw of a product with digital elements that can be exploited by a cyber threat
full_text: (40) ‘vulnerability’ means a weakness, susceptibility or flaw of a product with digital elements that can be exploited by a cyber threat;

definition_text: a vulnerability that has the potential to be effectively used by an adversary under practical operational conditions
full_text: (41) ‘exploitable vulnerability’ means a vulnerability that has the potential to be effectively used by an adversary under practical operational conditions;

definition_text: a vulnerability for which there is reliable evidence that a malicious actor has exploited it in a system without permission of the system owner
full_text: (42) ‘actively exploited vulnerability’ means a vulnerability for which there is reliable evidence that a malicious actor has exploited it in a system without permission of the system owner;

definition_text: an incident as defined in Article 6, point (6), of Directive (EU) 2022/2555
full_text: (43) ‘incident’ means an incident as defined in Article 6, point (6), of Directive (EU) 2022/2555;

term: incident having an impact on the security of the product with digital elements
definition_text: an incident that negatively affects or is capable of negatively affecting the ability of a product with digital elements to protect the availability, authenticity, integrity or confidentiality of data or functions
full_text: (44) ‘incident having an impact on the security of the product with digital elements’ means an incident that negatively affects or is capable of negatively affecting the ability of a product with digital elements to protect the availability, authenticity, integrity or confidentiality of data or functions;

definition_text: a near miss as defined in Article 6, point (5), of Directive (EU) 2022/2555
full_text: (45) ‘near miss’ means a near miss as defined in Article 6, point (5), of Directive (EU) 2022/2555;

definition_text: a cyber threat as defined in Article 2, point (8), of Regulation (EU) 2019/881
full_text: (46) ‘cyber threat’ means a cyber threat as defined in Article 2, point (8), of Regulation (EU) 2019/881;

definition_text: personal data as defined in Article 4, point (1), of Regulation (EU) 2016/679
full_text: (47) ‘personal data’ means personal data as defined in Article 4, point (1), of Regulation (EU) 2016/679;

definition_text: software the source code of which is openly shared and which is made available under a free and open-source licence which provides for all rights to make it freely accessible, usable, modifiable and redistributable
full_text: (48) ‘free and open-source software’ means software the source code of which is openly shared and which is made available under a free and open-source licence which provides for all rights to make it freely accessible, usable, modifiable and redistributable;

definition_text: recall as defined in Article 3, point (22), of Regulation (EU) 2019/1020
full_text: (49) ‘recall’ means recall as defined in Article 3, point (22), of Regulation (EU) 2019/1020;

definition_text: withdrawal as defined in Article 3, point (23), of Regulation (EU) 2019/1020
full_text: (50) ‘withdrawal’ means withdrawal as defined in Article 3, point (23), of Regulation (EU) 2019/1020;

definition_text: a CSIRT designated as coordinator pursuant to Article 12(1) of Directive (EU) 2022/2555.
full_text: (51) ‘CSIRT designated as coordinator’ means a CSIRT designated as coordinator pursuant to Article 12(1) of Directive (EU) 2022/2555.
